findings.issue: בַּהֶרֶת (H934) is a bright spot; «mancha» is a generic stain and drops the brightness.
Qal imperfect עָמַד stands or remains; «se parare» adds a pronominal middle and leans toward stopping.

notes: Debajo de ella, the qal perfect not-spread, cicatriz de la úlcera plus 3fs ella, and piel 3ms with a 3ms object on the priest match the tokens.
